name: The children of the post whom no source names
head: garrison_child_unnamed_1

present_on_scene_date.note: Counted with the eighteen children of 15 August (Quaife App. IX).

associated_with.note: After the April murders the settlers 'fortified themselves in the house formerly occupied by Jouett, the Indian agent' (Quaife ch. X); which of them were still there in August is not said.

not_in_this_household.note: A name or family found for any child retires one card.

persons.name: A child of the post, name not recorded (1 of 7)

present_on_scene_date.note: Presence on the afternoon of 14 August 1812, read from the evidence below; no source takes a roll call that afternoon.

persons.note: Woodward and Quaife count eighteen children with the evacuation (Helm's list reads 15 in Quaife's transcription and 18 in Gordon's); eleven can be put to a family by name, so seven are counted and unnamed, most likely more Lee, Burns, Holt or Needs children. This card stands for one of them; the family, age and name are not known.
